title: Recovering the absolute moment
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $q>0$. For the power mean $\|f\|_q=(\mathbb E|f|^q)^{1/q}$ under the uniform measure on the Boolean cube, $\|f\|_q^q=\mathbb E|f|^q$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ and $q>0$, the power mean $\|f\|_q=(\E|f|^q)^{1/q}$ satisfies $\|f\|_q^q=\E|f|^q$.
